body:
My dear friend,

What a lot of spring you've seen this week: fish and tadpoles, swallows and a ladybird, young trees and a roaring waterfall!

Mrs. Hannah would love to hear about it all. Why not write and tell her?
summary: Write a letter of spring news to Mrs. Hannah.
done: Your letter is on its way to the farm!

tasks.where: at the table by your door
at the coop by your house
in the grove behind the chapel
